role: translation of an L_R-formula eliminating the defined relation symbol R
notes: Metalinguistic operation Fm(L_R) -> Fm(L) relative to the standing defining formula; the operand is a formula, distinct from the global finite-iteration star whose operand is an alphabet or relation

role: simultaneous capture-avoiding instance of the defining formula
notes: Metalinguistic name of the L-formula built by renaming the defining variables to fresh z_i and then inserting t_i for z_i

role: defining expansion of an L-structure interpreting R by the relation defined by the defining formula
notes: Metalinguistic L_R-structure; its interpretation of R is the registered \(R^{\mathcal M}_{\varphi}\)

role: iterated assignment update at the defining variables
defining axiom of a defined function or constant symbol f
notes: Sentence forall x_1...x_m forall y (f(x_1,...,x_m)=y <-> phi); parallel to the relation-case delta_R

role: signature extending L by the defined function symbol f
notes: Same relation symbols as L; one new function symbol of arity m

role: existence (totality) sentence of a candidate function-defining formula
notes: forall x_1...x_m exists y phi; half of the unique-value premise

role: uniqueness sentence of a candidate function-defining formula
notes: forall x_1...x_m forall y forall y' ((phi and phi[y'/y]) -> y=y') with y' the least variable outside Var(phi) and the defining variables

role: function defined by phi in an L-structure in which phi is functional
notes: Sends each m-tuple to the unique b with (tuple,b) in R^M_phi for the list x_1,...,x_m,y

role: defining expansion of an L-structure interpreting f by the function defined by phi
notes: Defined only when phi is functional in M; distinct from the relation-case expansion M_phi by the superscript f

role: graph formula: L-formula saying that v denotes the value of the L_f-term t
notes: Defined for v not in Var(t); other registered Gr rows (P9 query graph, P12 ground instances, p02-041 partial-map graph) have different operands and scopes

role: translation of an L_f-formula eliminating the defined function symbol f
notes: Metalinguistic operation Fm(L_f) -> Fm(L); overlaps the P2 incidence-translation sharp and the p02-036 path translation sharp, which have other scopes

role: composite translation of an L_k-formula through a finite sequence of definitions
notes: Applies the step translations k, k-1, ..., 1 in turn
